poses.name: 01-run-in
poses.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one full-body ANIMATION KEY POSE for Mabel, Sugarfall's baker mascot. Reference image1 is the original painted Mabel and governs her exact adult face/age/brown eyes/warm freckles/chestnut swept curls and bun. Reference image2 is the approved turnaround and governs her full body proportions and costume: mint-green collared puff-sleeve dress, ivory apron with small strawberry on her left chest, copper fastenings, TWO apron pockets, waist sash tied at FRONT only, below-knee mint skirt, simple brown low shoes. Preserve this SAME woman, same costume and same softly painted sculpted 2.5D finish, warm upper-left light and restrained material texture. This is NOT the rejected simplified vector/cartoon puppet. One complete figure on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background; clean natural silhouette, no white sticker border, no black outline, no card, no scenery, no ground shadow outside figure, no labels/text. PORTRAIT composition about1024x1536, full bun and shoes and entire serving plate in view, at least8% margin around moving limbs. Keep body scale consistent: standing height fills about82% of canvas, feet near92% height. CAMERA: fixed frontal three-quarter camera, character moving toward the RIGHT of the image. Both eyes recognizable. No mirror-flipping outfit asymmetry. She carries the SAME oval ivory serving plate with thin copper rim in both hands, roughly waist height, long axis horizontal with slight natural foreshortening. Plate must be completely EMPTY: no food, balls, spoons or new objects; the real game treats will be separate animated layers. Hands have natural fingers and visibly support the plate. Her gaze follows an incoming treat above/right, not the camera. Mood capable and playful. Avoid fear, falling over, wobbly overloaded slapstick, exaggerated toddler proportions, princess costume, chef hat, new jewelry, photorealism or huge open mouth. Preserve consistent face/hair/plate/outfit across the key poses. ACTION: Running in toward image-right, focused but warm. Right leg extends forward to lead the stride, left leg pushes off behind; modest forward body lean, bun/curls and apron lag a little. Arms keep the empty plate level in front. Eyes look up/right at a falling treat. This is an active running stride, not walking or posing.
